column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
With a "See you later," both of our parents went out today.
I was sitting on the living room sofa with a carefree attitude, reading a manga I brought from my room.
Ahh... So relaxing.
Life can be this carefree when both parents are gone.
And what's more, they won't be back till tomorrow!
The time to enjoy my freedom is now!  Or so I thought...
Well, although both parents are gone, my sister is still here.
And looking at me with such a self-important expression, too.
I am in a REALLY bad mood today.
Now why did she announce that without being asked, I wonder...
Why would I have anything to do with her bad mood?
...Really?
So what am I supposed to do?! I have no idea!
Huh?!
No way, right? The date's canceled.
Date? With your friends, right?
Of course! Who else would it be with?
Well, I'm just getting bits and pieces. How should I know?
In other words, your friends canceled the date and now you're in a bad mood.
That's what I said from the start!
...Okay, calm down, my urge to fight.
Is this with Kuroneko and Saori?
No. The one I made a date with is a model friend.
You don't mean Ayase, right?
A different friend. I had plans to go buy some modeling dresses and check out the photo shoot location with her.
Ah, so that's why it can't be with Kuroneko and Saori.
That's right. That's why even though she called yesterday, I didn't answer.
You didn't answer?!
That's why I didn't think the date could be canceled!
And she was even a good modeling friend with whom I thought I could talk about a lot of things. I was really looking forward to it.
And then she said she had some special photo session and canceled at the last minute! Like, no way!
Well, it's not like I don't understand.
Last minute cancellation and feigning ignorance can't feel too good.
But, why bring this up with me?
And now she's directing this towards me?
And here I thought I could finally go shopping with her.
I don't know what she means by canceling at the last minute!
It's best to let sleeping dogs lie. Since I don't have my O.R.E. System (Order Record Effect) with me, all I can choose is just 'Through!'
Right, right. Anyway, I'm gonna go quietly back to my room and finish reading this manga.
Hold on.
...What?
I'm in a REALLY bad mood here.
You said that just now.
And I'm also REALLY bored now.  So go out with me.
Eh?  Me?
O, little sister who must taketh center stage.
No matter how you look at it, this 'going out' can't be a good thing, my survival instincts are warning me...  How can I avoid this Bad Event...
God has not abandoned me!
W-Wait, time out!
Hey, what, you think you're going to get out of this with a phone call?
But it's ringing by itself!
Hello!
Ah, Kyou-chan.
Oh?!  Manami!
I'm saved! With this, it looks like I can be free of Kirino's evil grasp!
W-What is it?
Um, Kyou-chan, are you free today?
I'm free, I'm free! I'm totally free!
We're preparing some new traditional sweets, and we were thinking you could come try them out.
Oh, I see!
If it's okay, can you come over?
I guess there's no choice since I'm the only one, right? No problem, no problem! Well then--huh?!
Kyou-chan, what's--
...The end.
Hey!  You... What do you think you're doing?!
...I'm the one you promised first, so what do you think you're doing, giving an okay on your own like that?
...P-Promised?!  How was that...
Alright, hurry up and get ready. As for plain girl, I'll send her an explanatory text message for you.
When she's like this, she'll be pushy until she gets her way.
*sigh*...  Having an obstinate little sister is tiring... Isn't that right, my fellow Elder-Brothers-In-Arms?
Fine... Geez, you don't have anyone else to go with, it seems...
Y-You just look like you wanted to go, so I asked you!
Why are you making this about what I want?! If you want to go, just go by yourself!
Fine! Is that the way it's going to be... Hmm?...
Is that the attitude you're going to take then... Hmm...?
What now?
I'm going to tell Mom and Dad that you've been devouring my friends with your eyes!
Huuuh?!?!
That was a misunderstanding!
Oh, no. That was no misunderstanding, because Ayase said she was getting chills up her spine from your stares.
I didn't stare!
Only for a second!
Wait, this isn't the time to be thinking about that!
Hey, wait! Who are you going to call?
Huh?  Why do I have to tell you?
Grrrrrr...
Damnit!
The people she'll call is pretty obvious in this case.
And? Well? I expect to go shopping.
Arghhhhh...
This girl is likely to tattle.
And of course, it'll be half-truths.
And of course, our parents would for some reason believe her.
How did it get like this?!
If that happens, I will lose my place in the Kousaka family...
Oh, fine. I shall accompany you, your majesty!
